c: Nice fightin', <name>--now let's see about that rocket ride, eh?
d:
If you're gonna take out the Big G, you're gonna have to bust a few heads - on the very same Ogre, as a matter of fact.

Mug'Zee's army of goons litter the Gallagio's shadiest back rooms. If you can secure the Tower of Spades, I'll drop you and your friends off there any time you like.
obj: Defeat Mug'Zee, Heads of Security within Liberation of Undermine on difficulty.
Defeat Mug'Zee, Heads of Security in the Liberation of Undermine raid on difficulty or higher.

c: Great job out there! Now these vehicles don't come with insurance so if you get into any trouble you're gonna have to solve it yourself.
d:
Alright. Before you go out and run somebody over let's make sure you know how to do it properly.

We'll introduce you to the car, the D.R.I.V.E. service we offer, and how to drive it in style.
obj: Learn how to drive the G-99 Breakneck.
Use the escape chains to reach the streets of Undermine (Optional)
Exit the G-99 Breakneck and install a turbo at the D.R.I.V.E.
Get back in the G-99 Breakneck and activate your boost
Get a job from Nanny Talullah
Complete your job from Nanny Talullah
p: Just put your foot on the pedal and the rest will come naturally.

c:
Are you alright? I tried to protect you from the blast.

Sorry. That took a lot. I just need a moment.
d:
We're too late! The ritual is self-sustaining. It'll draw in more power until it overloads the machine. Tazavesh, the eco-domes--nothing will be safe if the failure cascades. 

If we remove the infusers, the energy should dissipate before it can cause any harm. It's too powerful though. It will tear you apart if you try to get close, and I'm not strong enough to do it alone...

Unbind me. I'll wrap you in my energy. That should be enough to let you get close to the machine.

c: Ah, this shall do very nicely.
d:
Classics are classic for a reason, darling. One simply cannot host a worthwhile soiree without a fine selection of mana for one's guests to indulge in.

The Magisters could bring some, but mana is best when freshly siphoned. The mana wyrms in southern Eversong have a decadent brightness to them that I find particularly lovely.

Be a dear and gather some for us.
obj: Siphon magical energy from 6 Scintillant Wyrms in the Tranquil Repose.
p: Time is of the essence, dear.

c:
Thank you, <name>. And Jan'alai thanks ya too.

I know dis is my path. By blood and by my own heart. I may never follow my mother into battle, but she will understand I serve de Amani--and Jan'alai--in my own way.
d:
I know my uncle can seem... off at times. His talk of de loa always felt like childhood stories to me.

But ever since Jan'alai returned, I feel her energy too! She flickers, she smolders, she burns red hot. She also brings warmth, light, and life!

But what I feel from her right now is distress--dat of a mother hen counting her chicks but comin' up short.

Let's check on de hatchlings. We can cover more ground if we split up.
obj: Investigate what's going on with the new hatchlings.

c: I hope it brings his spirit peace. And mine.
d:
I will have to take what's left of de supplies back on foot.

De boat... it's no good now. De hull's cracked, and de frame's split. Won't carry another soul across de water.

But it'll still serve one final purpose.

It can be his pyre. We will burn it, de weapons, de armor he wore--everything with him.

Vengeance is done. Now we let de fire take him to de loa and to his rest.
obj: Prepare the funeral pyre for Tolbani in Atal'Abasi.
